verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Basecamp plugin or integration that runs inside a design tool and lets a designer update project status there. The Figma mention describes storing Figma cloud files inside Basecamp projects, which is the reverse direction and still means working in Basecamp. The REST API, CLI and MCP support are developer building blocks for building such an integration, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
